name: First Fintec Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2001, First Fintec Ltd is in the IT/ITES, KPO, ed-Tech and Fintech business[1]
keyPoints:
Business Verticals:[1]
a) Fintec: 
It is a combination of financial services and information technology
b) Analytics:
This involves analyzing data, using statistical models, and other quantitative methods. It does business analytics for decision making of businesses and institutional segments.
c) Edtec: 
Company's Edtech vertical has digital e-learning product suits for the K-10 segment for CBSE (English Medium) and Maharashtra, Telangana, & Andhra Pradesh State Board education curriculums in English and Vernacular Mediums. 
d) Invest Tec:
Invest Tec is an independent investment division focused on Venture Capital and Private Equity Advisory.
e) Fin Research Analytics:
Company is an independent research provider offering extensive industrial and financial research covering various sectors, businesses, and companies.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.68 times its book value
cons: Company has a low return on equity of -5.84% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 154 days.
Working capital days have increased from 142 days to 211 days
